pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: JUNB encodes transcription factor JunB. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include T-cell/histiocyte-rich large B-cell lymphoma; Nodular lymphocyte-predominant Hodgkin lymphoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
